description: Assigns each lat/lon record to the nearest origin point within a maximum straight-line distance threshold. Uses haversine distance — no routing API required, no cost per lookup. Use for recruitment catchment analysis (which high schools are within 50 miles of campus?), service area mapping (which students live within reach of a tutoring center?), or regional alumni density analysis. Origin points are loaded from a CSV in S3.

origins_uri.description: S3 path to a CSV of origin points with columns: lat, lon, and a label column

max_distance_km.description: Maximum straight-line distance in km to be considered within catchment (default 80 km / ~50 miles)

label_column.description: Column name in origins CSV to use as the origin label (default: 'label')
